title: EEG data offline and online during motor imagery for standing and sitting
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 32 participants performing motor imagery tasks related to standing and sitting transitions, collected both offline and online using a brain-computer interface (BCI). Participants underwent structured sessions with cued motor imagery and idle state tasks for sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit movements, with EEG data recorded from 17 scalp electrodes referenced to the right mastoid. The dataset supports research on decoding EEG rhythms for BCI applications in postural transitions.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using 17 channels (F3, Fz, F4, FC5, FC1, FC2, FC6, C3, Cz, C4, CP5, CP1, CP2, CP6, P3, Pz, P4) following the 10-20 system, grounded to AFz and referenced to the right mastoid (M2), at a sampling frequency of 250Hz. Experiments included an offline phase with cued motor imagery and idle state trials for sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit tasks, followed by an online phase using BCI-based real-time classification. Marker codes encoded trial phases and task types.
